if (RS_PATTERNS[i].test(text)) {

<script>
(function () {
  // Languages ReadSpeaker can read on this site. Google Translate codes.
  // 'en' with no region covers en-GB, en-AU etc.
  // 'zh-CN' is region-specific on purpose: Simplified only, not zh-TW.
  var RS_SUPPORTED = ['en', 'zh-CN'];

  var FALLBACK_TEXT =
    'The Listen button can read this page in English and Simplified Chinese.\n\n' +
    'For other languages, see the separate method set out on our ' +
    'Accessibility page, or switch the page back to English and select ' +
    'Listen again.\n\n' +
    'Need a hand? Email webmaster@goldcoast.qld.gov.au';

  function dialogEl() { return document.getElementById('rs-lang-dialog'); }

  // --- which language is the visitor actually reading? --------------------
  function currentLanguage() {
    var m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)googtrans=([^;]+)/);
    if (m) {
      var target = decodeURIComponent(m[1]).split('/')[2];
      if (target) return target;
    }
    // Cookie missing but a translation is active — read Google's own dropdown
    var combo = document.querySelector('.goog-te-combo');
    if (combo && combo.value) return combo.value;

    if (/\btranslated-(ltr|rtl)\b/.test(document.documentElement.className)) {
      return 'unknown';
    }
    return null;   // not translated
  }

  function isSupported(code) {
    if (!code) return true;              // untranslated — original English
    if (code === 'unknown') return false; // translated, can't tell which
    code = code.toLowerCase();
    for (var i = 0; i < RS_SUPPORTED.length; i++) {
      var s = RS_SUPPORTED[i].toLowerCase();
      if (code === s) return true;
      // bare codes match their regional variants; 'zh-CN' never matches 'zh-TW'
      if (s.indexOf('-') === -1 && code.indexOf(s + '-') === 0) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  window.__rsLanguageSupported = function () { return isSupported(currentLanguage()); };

  // --- GA4: count each time the dialog is shown ---------------------------
  function trackDialogView() {
    try {
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({
        event: 'rs_dialog_view',
        page_language: currentLanguage() || 'en'
      });
    } catch (err) { /* tracking must never break the dialog */ }
  }

  // --- dialog ------------------------------------------------------------
  (function enhanceClose() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    var close = dlg && dlg.querySelector('[data-rs-close]');
    if (!close) return;
    if (!close.getAttribute('role'))     close.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    if (!close.hasAttribute('tabindex')) close.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  })();

  window.showListenUnavailable = function () {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || typeof dlg.showModal !== 'function') {
      trackDialogView();
      window.__rsNativeAlert(FALLBACK_TEXT);
      return;
    }
    if (dlg.open) return;
    trackDialogView();
    dlg.showModal();
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      dlg.classList.add('is-open');
      var primary = dlg.querySelector('.solidTealButton');
      if (primary) primary.focus();
    });
  };

  function closeDialog() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !dlg.open) return;
    dlg.classList.remove('is-open');
    setTimeout(function () { if (dlg.open) dlg.close(); }, 180);
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !e.target.closest) return;
    if (e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); return; }
    if (e.target === dlg) closeDialog();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ' && e.key !== 'Spacebar') return;
    if (!e.target.closest || !e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    closeDialog();
  });

  document.addEventListener('cancel', function (e) {
    if (e.target && e.target.id === 'rs-lang-dialog') { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); }
  });

  // --- only intercept when the language genuinely isn't supported ---------
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest) return;
    var btn = e.target.closest('.rsbtn_play');
    if (!btn) return;
    if (isSupported(currentLanguage())) return;   // let ReadSpeaker run

    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    window.showListenUnavailable();
  }, true);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  var NEW_LABEL = 'Select language';
  var DEFAULT_LABEL = 'English';

  function apply(label) {
    if (label.textContent.trim() !== DEFAULT_LABEL) return;
    label.textContent = NEW_LABEL;

    // keep the screen-reader sentence accurate
    var btn = label.closest('button');
    var sr = btn && btn.querySelector('.visuallyhidden');
    if (sr) sr.textContent = ' \u2014 English is your current preferred language.';
  }

  function init() {
    var label = document.getElementById('toolbar-language-label');
    if (!label) return false;

    apply(label);

    // re-apply if the toolbar's own script rewrites the label after us
    new MutationObserver(function () { apply(label); })
      .observe(label, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });

    return true;
  }

  function start() {
    if (init()) return;
    // button is built by the toolbar's JS — wait for it
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function (m, o) { if (init()) o.disconnect(); });
    obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function () { obs.disconnect(); }, 10000);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
</script>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

<script>

if (RS_PATTERNS[i].test(text)) {

<script>
(function () {
  // Languages ReadSpeaker can read on this site. Google Translate codes.
  // 'en' with no region covers en-GB, en-AU etc.
  // 'zh-CN' is region-specific on purpose: Simplified only, not zh-TW.
  var RS_SUPPORTED = ['en', 'zh-CN'];

  var FALLBACK_TEXT =
    'The Listen button can read this page in English and Simplified Chinese.\n\n' +
    'For other languages, see the separate method set out on our ' +
    'Accessibility page, or switch the page back to English and select ' +
    'Listen again.\n\n' +
    'Need a hand? Email webmaster@goldcoast.qld.gov.au';

  function dialogEl() { return document.getElementById('rs-lang-dialog'); }

  // --- which language is the visitor actually reading? --------------------
  function currentLanguage() {
    var m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)googtrans=([^;]+)/);
    if (m) {
      var target = decodeURIComponent(m[1]).split('/')[2];
      if (target) return target;
    }
    // Cookie missing but a translation is active — read Google's own dropdown
    var combo = document.querySelector('.goog-te-combo');
    if (combo && combo.value) return combo.value;

    if (/\btranslated-(ltr|rtl)\b/.test(document.documentElement.className)) {
      return 'unknown';
    }
    return null;   // not translated
  }

  function isSupported(code) {
    if (!code) return true;              // untranslated — original English
    if (code === 'unknown') return false; // translated, can't tell which
    code = code.toLowerCase();
    for (var i = 0; i < RS_SUPPORTED.length; i++) {
      var s = RS_SUPPORTED[i].toLowerCase();
      if (code === s) return true;
      // bare codes match their regional variants; 'zh-CN' never matches 'zh-TW'
      if (s.indexOf('-') === -1 && code.indexOf(s + '-') === 0) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  window.__rsLanguageSupported = function () { return isSupported(currentLanguage()); };

  // --- GA4: count each time the dialog is shown ---------------------------
  function trackDialogView() {
    try {
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({
        event: 'rs_dialog_view',
        page_language: currentLanguage() || 'en'
      });
    } catch (err) { /* tracking must never break the dialog */ }
  }

  // --- dialog ------------------------------------------------------------
  (function enhanceClose() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    var close = dlg && dlg.querySelector('[data-rs-close]');
    if (!close) return;
    if (!close.getAttribute('role'))     close.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    if (!close.hasAttribute('tabindex')) close.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  })();

  window.showListenUnavailable = function () {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || typeof dlg.showModal !== 'function') {
      trackDialogView();
      window.__rsNativeAlert(FALLBACK_TEXT);
      return;
    }
    if (dlg.open) return;
    trackDialogView();
    dlg.showModal();
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      dlg.classList.add('is-open');
      var primary = dlg.querySelector('.solidTealButton');
      if (primary) primary.focus();
    });
  };

  function closeDialog() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !dlg.open) return;
    dlg.classList.remove('is-open');
    setTimeout(function () { if (dlg.open) dlg.close(); }, 180);
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !e.target.closest) return;
    if (e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); return; }
    if (e.target === dlg) closeDialog();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ' && e.key !== 'Spacebar') return;
    if (!e.target.closest || !e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    closeDialog();
  });

  document.addEventListener('cancel', function (e) {
    if (e.target && e.target.id === 'rs-lang-dialog') { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); }
  });

  // --- only intercept when the language genuinely isn't supported ---------
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest) return;
    var btn = e.target.closest('.rsbtn_play');
    if (!btn) return;
    if (isSupported(currentLanguage())) return;   // let ReadSpeaker run

    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    window.showListenUnavailable();
  }, true);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  var NEW_LABEL = 'Select language';
  var DEFAULT_LABEL = 'English';

  function apply(label) {
    if (label.textContent.trim() !== DEFAULT_LABEL) return;
    label.textContent = NEW_LABEL;

    // keep the screen-reader sentence accurate
    var btn = label.closest('button');
    var sr = btn && btn.querySelector('.visuallyhidden');
    if (sr) sr.textContent = ' \u2014 English is your current preferred language.';
  }

  function init() {
    var label = document.getElementById('toolbar-language-label');
    if (!label) return false;

    apply(label);

    // re-apply if the toolbar's own script rewrites the label after us
    new MutationObserver(function () { apply(label); })
      .observe(label, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });

    return true;
  }

  function start() {
    if (init()) return;
    // button is built by the toolbar's JS — wait for it
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function (m, o) { if (init()) o.disconnect(); });
    obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function () { obs.disconnect(); }, 10000);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);

                    }

<script>
(function () {
  // Languages ReadSpeaker can read on this site. Google Translate codes.
  // 'en' with no region covers en-GB, en-AU etc.
  // 'zh-CN' is region-specific on purpose: Simplified only, not zh-TW.
  var RS_SUPPORTED = ['en', 'zh-CN'];

  var FALLBACK_TEXT =
    'The Listen button can read this page in English and Simplified Chinese.\n\n' +
    'For other languages, see the separate method set out on our ' +
    'Accessibility page, or switch the page back to English and select ' +
    'Listen again.\n\n' +
    'Need a hand? Email webmaster@goldcoast.qld.gov.au';

  function dialogEl() { return document.getElementById('rs-lang-dialog'); }

  // --- which language is the visitor actually reading? --------------------
  function currentLanguage() {
    var m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)googtrans=([^;]+)/);
    if (m) {
      var target = decodeURIComponent(m[1]).split('/')[2];
      if (target) return target;
    }
    // Cookie missing but a translation is active — read Google's own dropdown
    var combo = document.querySelector('.goog-te-combo');
    if (combo && combo.value) return combo.value;

    if (/\btranslated-(ltr|rtl)\b/.test(document.documentElement.className)) {
      return 'unknown';
    }
    return null;   // not translated
  }

  function isSupported(code) {
    if (!code) return true;              // untranslated — original English
    if (code === 'unknown') return false; // translated, can't tell which
    code = code.toLowerCase();
    for (var i = 0; i < RS_SUPPORTED.length; i++) {
      var s = RS_SUPPORTED[i].toLowerCase();
      if (code === s) return true;
      // bare codes match their regional variants; 'zh-CN' never matches 'zh-TW'
      if (s.indexOf('-') === -1 && code.indexOf(s + '-') === 0) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  window.__rsLanguageSupported = function () { return isSupported(currentLanguage()); };

  // --- GA4: count each time the dialog is shown ---------------------------
  function trackDialogView() {
    try {
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({
        event: 'rs_dialog_view',
        page_language: currentLanguage() || 'en'
      });
    } catch (err) { /* tracking must never break the dialog */ }
  }

  // --- dialog ------------------------------------------------------------
  (function enhanceClose() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    var close = dlg && dlg.querySelector('[data-rs-close]');
    if (!close) return;
    if (!close.getAttribute('role'))     close.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    if (!close.hasAttribute('tabindex')) close.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  })();

  window.showListenUnavailable = function () {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || typeof dlg.showModal !== 'function') {
      trackDialogView();
      window.__rsNativeAlert(FALLBACK_TEXT);
      return;
    }
    if (dlg.open) return;
    trackDialogView();
    dlg.showModal();
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      dlg.classList.add('is-open');
      var primary = dlg.querySelector('.solidTealButton');
      if (primary) primary.focus();
    });
  };

  function closeDialog() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !dlg.open) return;
    dlg.classList.remove('is-open');
    setTimeout(function () { if (dlg.open) dlg.close(); }, 180);
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !e.target.closest) return;
    if (e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); return; }
    if (e.target === dlg) closeDialog();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ' && e.key !== 'Spacebar') return;
    if (!e.target.closest || !e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    closeDialog();
  });

  document.addEventListener('cancel', function (e) {
    if (e.target && e.target.id === 'rs-lang-dialog') { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); }
  });

  // --- only intercept when the language genuinely isn't supported ---------
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest) return;
    var btn = e.target.closest('.rsbtn_play');
    if (!btn) return;
    if (isSupported(currentLanguage())) return;   // let ReadSpeaker run

    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    window.showListenUnavailable();
  }, true);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  var NEW_LABEL = 'Select language';
  var DEFAULT_LABEL = 'English';

  function apply(label) {
    if (label.textContent.trim() !== DEFAULT_LABEL) return;
    label.textContent = NEW_LABEL;

    // keep the screen-reader sentence accurate
    var btn = label.closest('button');
    var sr = btn && btn.querySelector('.visuallyhidden');
    if (sr) sr.textContent = ' \u2014 English is your current preferred language.';
  }

  function init() {
    var label = document.getElementById('toolbar-language-label');
    if (!label) return false;

    apply(label);

    // re-apply if the toolbar's own script rewrites the label after us
    new MutationObserver(function () { apply(label); })
      .observe(label, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });

    return true;
  }

  function start() {
    if (init()) return;
    // button is built by the toolbar's JS — wait for it
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function (m, o) { if (init()) o.disconnect(); });
    obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function () { obs.disconnect(); }, 10000);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  // Languages ReadSpeaker can read on this site. Google Translate codes.
  // 'en' with no region covers en-GB, en-AU etc.
  // 'zh-CN' is region-specific on purpose: Simplified only, not zh-TW.
  var RS_SUPPORTED = ['en', 'zh-CN'];

  var FALLBACK_TEXT =
    'The Listen button can read this page in English and Simplified Chinese.\n\n' +
    'For other languages, see the separate method set out on our ' +
    'Accessibility page, or switch the page back to English and select ' +
    'Listen again.\n\n' +
    'Need a hand? Email webmaster@goldcoast.qld.gov.au';

  function dialogEl() { return document.getElementById('rs-lang-dialog'); }

  // --- which language is the visitor actually reading? --------------------
  function currentLanguage() {
    var m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)googtrans=([^;]+)/);
    if (m) {
      var target = decodeURIComponent(m[1]).split('/')[2];
      if (target) return target;
    }
    // Cookie missing but a translation is active — read Google's own dropdown
    var combo = document.querySelector('.goog-te-combo');
    if (combo && combo.value) return combo.value;

    if (/\btranslated-(ltr|rtl)\b/.test(document.documentElement.className)) {
      return 'unknown';
    }
    return null;   // not translated
  }

  function isSupported(code) {
    if (!code) return true;              // untranslated — original English
    if (code === 'unknown') return false; // translated, can't tell which
    code = code.toLowerCase();
    for (var i = 0; i < RS_SUPPORTED.length; i++) {
      var s = RS_SUPPORTED[i].toLowerCase();
      if (code === s) return true;
      // bare codes match their regional variants; 'zh-CN' never matches 'zh-TW'
      if (s.indexOf('-') === -1 && code.indexOf(s + '-') === 0) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  window.__rsLanguageSupported = function () { return isSupported(currentLanguage()); };

  // --- GA4: count each time the dialog is shown ---------------------------
  function trackDialogView() {
    try {
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({
        event: 'rs_dialog_view',
        page_language: currentLanguage() || 'en'
      });
    } catch (err) { /* tracking must never break the dialog */ }
  }

  // --- dialog ------------------------------------------------------------
  (function enhanceClose() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    var close = dlg && dlg.querySelector('[data-rs-close]');
    if (!close) return;
    if (!close.getAttribute('role'))     close.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    if (!close.hasAttribute('tabindex')) close.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  })();

  window.showListenUnavailable = function () {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || typeof dlg.showModal !== 'function') {
      trackDialogView();
      window.__rsNativeAlert(FALLBACK_TEXT);
      return;
    }
    if (dlg.open) return;
    trackDialogView();
    dlg.showModal();
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      dlg.classList.add('is-open');
      var primary = dlg.querySelector('.solidTealButton');
      if (primary) primary.focus();
    });
  };

  function closeDialog() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !dlg.open) return;
    dlg.classList.remove('is-open');
    setTimeout(function () { if (dlg.open) dlg.close(); }, 180);
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !e.target.closest) return;
    if (e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); return; }
    if (e.target === dlg) closeDialog();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ' && e.key !== 'Spacebar') return;
    if (!e.target.closest || !e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    closeDialog();
  });

    if (e.target && e.target.id === 'rs-lang-dialog') { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); }

    if (!e.target.closest) return;
    var btn = e.target.closest('.rsbtn_play');

    if (isSupported(currentLanguage())) return;   // let ReadSpeaker run

    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    window.showListenUnavailable();
  }, true);
})();

<script>
(function () {
  var NEW_LABEL = 'Select language';
  var DEFAULT_LABEL = 'English';

  function apply(label) {
    if (label.textContent.trim() !== DEFAULT_LABEL) return;
    label.textContent = NEW_LABEL;

    // keep the screen-reader sentence accurate
    var btn = label.closest('button');
    var sr = btn && btn.querySelector('.visuallyhidden');
    if (sr) sr.textContent = ' \u2014 English is your current preferred language.';
  }

  function init() {
    var label = document.getElementById('toolbar-language-label');
    if (!label) return false;

    apply(label);

    // re-apply if the toolbar's own script rewrites the label after us
    new MutationObserver(function () { apply(label); })
      .observe(label, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });

    return true;
  }

  function start() {
    if (init()) return;
    // button is built by the toolbar's JS — wait for it
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function (m, o) { if (init()) o.disconnect(); });
    obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function () { obs.disconnect(); }, 10000);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
</script>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

      var primary = dlg.querySelector('.solidTealButton');
      if (primary) primary.focus();

  };

    if (!dlg || !dlg.open) return;

    if (!dlg || !e.target.closest) return;

<script>
(function () {
  var NEW_LABEL = 'Select language';
  var DEFAULT_LABEL = 'English';

  function apply(label) {
    if (label.textContent.trim() !== DEFAULT_LABEL) return;
    label.textContent = NEW_LABEL;

    // keep the screen-reader sentence accurate
    var btn = label.closest('button');
    var sr = btn && btn.querySelector('.visuallyhidden');
    if (sr) sr.textContent = ' \u2014 English is your current preferred language.';
  }

  function init() {
    var label = document.getElementById('toolbar-language-label');
    if (!label) return false;

    apply(label);

    // re-apply if the toolbar's own script rewrites the label after us
    new MutationObserver(function () { apply(label); })
      .observe(label, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });

    return true;
  }

  function start() {
    if (init()) return;
    // button is built by the toolbar's JS — wait for it
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function (m, o) { if (init()) o.disconnect(); });
    obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function () { obs.disconnect(); }, 10000);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
</script>

        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||

                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {

                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {

                    }

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Minutes & agendas</h1>

if (RS_PATTERNS[i].test(text)) {

<script>
(function () {
  // Languages ReadSpeaker can read on this site. Google Translate codes.
  // 'en' with no region covers en-GB, en-AU etc.
  // 'zh-CN' is region-specific on purpose: Simplified only, not zh-TW.
  var RS_SUPPORTED = ['en', 'zh-CN'];

  var FALLBACK_TEXT =
    'The Listen button can read this page in English and Simplified Chinese.\n\n' +
    'For other languages, see the separate method set out on our ' +
    'Accessibility page, or switch the page back to English and select ' +
    'Listen again.\n\n' +
    'Need a hand? Email webmaster@goldcoast.qld.gov.au';

  function dialogEl() { return document.getElementById('rs-lang-dialog'); }

  // --- which language is the visitor actually reading? --------------------
  function currentLanguage() {
    var m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)googtrans=([^;]+)/);
    if (m) {
      var target = decodeURIComponent(m[1]).split('/')[2];
      if (target) return target;
    }
    // Cookie missing but a translation is active — read Google's own dropdown
    var combo = document.querySelector('.goog-te-combo');
    if (combo && combo.value) return combo.value;

    if (/\btranslated-(ltr|rtl)\b/.test(document.documentElement.className)) {
      return 'unknown';
    }
    return null;   // not translated
  }

  function isSupported(code) {
    if (!code) return true;              // untranslated — original English
    if (code === 'unknown') return false; // translated, can't tell which
    code = code.toLowerCase();
    for (var i = 0; i < RS_SUPPORTED.length; i++) {
      var s = RS_SUPPORTED[i].toLowerCase();
      if (code === s) return true;
      // bare codes match their regional variants; 'zh-CN' never matches 'zh-TW'
      if (s.indexOf('-') === -1 && code.indexOf(s + '-') === 0) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  window.__rsLanguageSupported = function () { return isSupported(currentLanguage()); };

  // --- GA4: count each time the dialog is shown ---------------------------
  function trackDialogView() {
    try {
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({
        event: 'rs_dialog_view',
        page_language: currentLanguage() || 'en'
      });
    } catch (err) { /* tracking must never break the dialog */ }
  }

  // --- dialog ------------------------------------------------------------
  (function enhanceClose() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    var close = dlg && dlg.querySelector('[data-rs-close]');
    if (!close) return;
    if (!close.getAttribute('role'))     close.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    if (!close.hasAttribute('tabindex')) close.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  })();

  window.showListenUnavailable = function () {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || typeof dlg.showModal !== 'function') {
      trackDialogView();
      window.__rsNativeAlert(FALLBACK_TEXT);
      return;
    }
    if (dlg.open) return;
    trackDialogView();
    dlg.showModal();
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      dlg.classList.add('is-open');
      var primary = dlg.querySelector('.solidTealButton');
      if (primary) primary.focus();
    });
  };

  function closeDialog() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !dlg.open) return;
    dlg.classList.remove('is-open');
    setTimeout(function () { if (dlg.open) dlg.close(); }, 180);
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !e.target.closest) return;
    if (e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); return; }
    if (e.target === dlg) closeDialog();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ' && e.key !== 'Spacebar') return;
    if (!e.target.closest || !e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    closeDialog();
  });

  document.addEventListener('cancel', function (e) {
    if (e.target && e.target.id === 'rs-lang-dialog') { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); }
  });

  // --- only intercept when the language genuinely isn't supported ---------
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest) return;
    var btn = e.target.closest('.rsbtn_play');
    if (!btn) return;
    if (isSupported(currentLanguage())) return;   // let ReadSpeaker run

    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    window.showListenUnavailable();
  }, true);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  var NEW_LABEL = 'Select language';
  var DEFAULT_LABEL = 'English';

  function apply(label) {
    if (label.textContent.trim() !== DEFAULT_LABEL) return;
    label.textContent = NEW_LABEL;

    // keep the screen-reader sentence accurate
    var btn = label.closest('button');
    var sr = btn && btn.querySelector('.visuallyhidden');
    if (sr) sr.textContent = ' \u2014 English is your current preferred language.';
  }

  function init() {
    var label = document.getElementById('toolbar-language-label');
    if (!label) return false;

    apply(label);

    // re-apply if the toolbar's own script rewrites the label after us
    new MutationObserver(function () { apply(label); })
      .observe(label, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });

    return true;
  }

  function start() {
    if (init()) return;
    // button is built by the toolbar's JS — wait for it
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function (m, o) { if (init()) o.disconnect(); });
    obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function () { obs.disconnect(); }, 10000);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

<!-- This script hides the top white google translate banner that comes up when the user selects a different language -->
<script type="text/javascript">
(function() {
    // Function to force hide the Google elements and reset the layout
    function annihilateGoogleBanner() {
        // Target Google's iframe container classes
        const googleIframes = document.querySelectorAll('iframe[class*="VIpgJd"], .goog-te-banner-frame');
        googleIframes.forEach(iframe => {
            iframe.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
            iframe.style.setProperty('visibility', 'hidden', 'important');
            iframe.style.setProperty('height', '0px', 'important');
        });

        // Prevent Google from pushing your website body down
        if (document.body) {
            document.body.style.setProperty('top', '0px', 'important');
            document.body.style.setProperty('position', 'static', 'important');
        }
        
        // Fix for html element shifts
        const htmlElem = document.documentElement;
        if (htmlElem) {
            htmlElem.style.setProperty('top', '0px', 'important');
        }
    }

    // Set up an observer to watch the website for dynamic changes
    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        annihilateGoogleBanner();
    });

    // Start watching the page as soon as the DOM begins loading
    observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['style', 'class']
    });

    // Run a safety check once the page completely finishes loading
    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', annihilateGoogleBanner);
    window.addEventListener('load', annihilateGoogleBanner);
})();
</script>

(function () {
  var nativeAlert = window.alert;

  window.__rsNativeAlert = function (msg) { nativeAlert.call(window, msg); };

  // Match on a stable fragment of the RS message
  var RS_PATTERNS = [
    /Listen button is not supported/i,
    /request audio support for this language/i
  ];

  window.alert = function (msg) {
    var text = String(msg == null ? '' : msg);
if (RS_PATTERNS[i].test(text)) {
  if (window.__rsLanguageSupported && window.__rsLanguageSupported()) {
    return; // supported language — swallow silently, don't show a wrong message

    window.showListenUnavailable();
  }
  return;
}

<script>
(function () {
  // Languages ReadSpeaker can read on this site. Google Translate codes.
  // 'en' with no region covers en-GB, en-AU etc.
  // 'zh-CN' is region-specific on purpose: Simplified only, not zh-TW.
  var RS_SUPPORTED = ['en', 'zh-CN'];

  var FALLBACK_TEXT =
    'The Listen button can read this page in English and Simplified Chinese.\n\n' +
    'For other languages, see the separate method set out on our ' +
    'Accessibility page, or switch the page back to English and select ' +
    'Listen again.\n\n' +
    'Need a hand? Email webmaster@goldcoast.qld.gov.au';

  function dialogEl() { return document.getElementById('rs-lang-dialog'); }

  // --- which language is the visitor actually reading? --------------------
  function currentLanguage() {
    var m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)googtrans=([^;]+)/);
    if (m) {
      var target = decodeURIComponent(m[1]).split('/')[2];
      if (target) return target;
    }
    // Cookie missing but a translation is active — read Google's own dropdown
    var combo = document.querySelector('.goog-te-combo');
    if (combo && combo.value) return combo.value;

    if (/\btranslated-(ltr|rtl)\b/.test(document.documentElement.className)) {
      return 'unknown';
    }
    return null;   // not translated
  }

  function isSupported(code) {
    if (!code) return true;              // untranslated — original English
    if (code === 'unknown') return false; // translated, can't tell which
    code = code.toLowerCase();
    for (var i = 0; i < RS_SUPPORTED.length; i++) {
      var s = RS_SUPPORTED[i].toLowerCase();
      if (code === s) return true;
      // bare codes match their regional variants; 'zh-CN' never matches 'zh-TW'
      if (s.indexOf('-') === -1 && code.indexOf(s + '-') === 0) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  window.__rsLanguageSupported = function () { return isSupported(currentLanguage()); };

  // --- GA4: count each time the dialog is shown ---------------------------
  function trackDialogView() {
    try {
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({
        event: 'rs_dialog_view',
        page_language: currentLanguage() || 'en'
      });
    } catch (err) { /* tracking must never break the dialog */ }
  }

  // --- dialog ------------------------------------------------------------
  (function enhanceClose() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    var close = dlg && dlg.querySelector('[data-rs-close]');
    if (!close) return;
    if (!close.getAttribute('role'))     close.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    if (!close.hasAttribute('tabindex')) close.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  })();

  window.showListenUnavailable = function () {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || typeof dlg.showModal !== 'function') {
      trackDialogView();
      window.__rsNativeAlert(FALLBACK_TEXT);
      return;
    }
    if (dlg.open) return;
    trackDialogView();
    dlg.showModal();
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      dlg.classList.add('is-open');
      var primary = dlg.querySelector('.solidTealButton');
      if (primary) primary.focus();
    });
  };

  function closeDialog() {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !dlg.open) return;
    dlg.classList.remove('is-open');
    setTimeout(function () { if (dlg.open) dlg.close(); }, 180);
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var dlg = dialogEl();
    if (!dlg || !e.target.closest) return;
    if (e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); return; }
    if (e.target === dlg) closeDialog();
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ' && e.key !== 'Spacebar') return;
    if (!e.target.closest || !e.target.closest('[data-rs-close]')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    closeDialog();
  });

  document.addEventListener('cancel', function (e) {
    if (e.target && e.target.id === 'rs-lang-dialog') { e.preventDefault(); closeDialog(); }
  });

  // --- only intercept when the language genuinely isn't supported ---------
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest) return;
    var btn = e.target.closest('.rsbtn_play');
    if (!btn) return;
    if (isSupported(currentLanguage())) return;   // let ReadSpeaker run

    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    window.showListenUnavailable();
  }, true);

<script>
(function () {
  var NEW_LABEL = 'Select language';
  var DEFAULT_LABEL = 'English';

  function apply(label) {
    if (label.textContent.trim() !== DEFAULT_LABEL) return;
    label.textContent = NEW_LABEL;

    // keep the screen-reader sentence accurate
    var btn = label.closest('button');
    var sr = btn && btn.querySelector('.visuallyhidden');
    if (sr) sr.textContent = ' \u2014 English is your current preferred language.';
  }

  function init() {
    var label = document.getElementById('toolbar-language-label');
    if (!label) return false;

    apply(label);

    // re-apply if the toolbar's own script rewrites the label after us
    new MutationObserver(function () { apply(label); })
      .observe(label, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });

    return true;
  }

  function start() {
    if (init()) return;
    // button is built by the toolbar's JS — wait for it
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function (m, o) { if (init()) o.disconnect(); });
    obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    setTimeout(function () { obs.disconnect(); }, 10000);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
</script>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);

                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
